headline: Executive order on the federal government taking a leading role in using vehicles that run on alternative fuels.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order deals with federal agencies using alternative fueled vehicles, meaning cars and trucks that can run on fuels other than regular gasoline or diesel. It appears meant to have the federal government set an example in adopting these vehicles. No summary was provided, so the specific rules, targets, and deadlines are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that operate vehicle fleets
who_it_affects.how: They are likely directed to buy or use more vehicles that run on alternative fuels.
